summary:
NextEra Energy最新季度每股盈餘與營收皆優於預期，受惠於強勁的再生能源需求與公用事業成長。
• 每股盈餘為1.15美元，優於市場預期的1.11美元。
• 營收達7.53億美元，年增12.45%。
• 再生能源與潔淨能源業務維持穩健擴張。
• 佛羅里達電力與照明公司（FPL）核心業務表現持續強勁。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健展現綠能龍頭優勢。短中期有助於支撐評價與股價表現，需持續追蹤利率走勢、資本支出回收進度及新專案併網狀況。

需留意：資本支出龐大可能對現金流與融資成本造成壓力。；供應鏈瓶頸與利率變動可能影響再生能源專案的執行進度。

summary_en:
NextEra Energy reported better-than-expected EPS and revenue, driven by strong renewable energy demand and utility growth.
• EPS of $1.15 beat the estimated $1.11.
• Revenue reached $7.53B, representing a 12.45% YoY growth.
• Renewable and clean energy segments continued steady expansion.
• Florida Power & Light core utility operations remained robust.

ai_view_en:
View: Solid results highlight leadership in clean energy. This supports valuation and near-to-mid-term stock performance. Track interest rate trends, capital expenditure recovery, and new project interconnection rates.

Watch：Heavy capital expenditures could pressure cash flow and financing costs.; Supply chain bottlenecks and interest rate fluctuations may impact renewable project timelines.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 1.15美元高於預估的1.11美元，營收達75.3億美元。
